# Vera's Clock

> A one-screen, picture-led app for picking a date and a time and sending it as an image. It is built for Vera, a stroke survivor who uses one hand and cannot read sentences.

The user taps a day on a large calendar, sets an analogue clock (tap the hour, then the minute), and chooses AM or PM. The 📸 button draws a picture of the chosen date and time and opens the phone's share sheet. The 🇨🇦 button shows the same moment in Vancouver time, and 🔄 returns to the live current time. The UI has no sentences or dialogs; every control is an emoji, icon, or colour. It is a static site with no server, accounts, or data collection.
